dependency_snapshot.workspace_note: All candidate artifacts use these live path dependencies. Hypermesh remained outside this work. Hyperlimit's retained-line evidence work was committed independently at the recorded revision; two mechanically required retained-orientation arguments were validated transitively by the complete Hypercurve gates. Pre-existing untracked Hyperlimit fuzz artifacts and corpora were not modified.

semantic_evidence.authoritative_route: CurveRegion2::offset enters offset_raw and offset_exact_general_raw. A private exact_axis_aligned_algebraic_offset_loop fast path constructs exact raw boundary fragments and then rejoins regularized_region_raw and CurveRegionBooleanContext; it is not a second public offset or Boolean engine.
semantic_evidence.carrier_translation: An axis-aligned BezierAlgebraicChord2 endpoint retained as a selected rational image N(alpha)/D(alpha) is translated in the same selected field as (N(alpha) + delta*D(alpha))/D(alpha). No endpoint is rounded or flattened into an independently rediscovered scalar root.
semantic_evidence.mixed_and_repeated_input: Loops may mix retained algebraic chords with exactly materialized line fragments. Exact endpoints lower to the native materialized line representation; genuinely selected endpoints remain compact algebraic chords, allowing output to re-enter a subsequent offset.
semantic_evidence.join_semantics: Miter, exact miter-limit comparison with bevel fallback, and bevel joins are constructed exactly. Convex orthogonal miter joins are folded into adjacent translated spans before arrangement, avoiding detour fragments and preserving a minimal four-edge rectangle.
semantic_evidence.collapse_semantics: Exact span direction and endpoint equality detect zero or reversed spans. A convex inward loop that has crossed its collapse distance is removed with its component role and fill metadata. A nonconvex loop after a local wavefront collapse returns Unsupported until topology scheduling is authoritative; it never emits the known-invalid contour.
semantic_evidence.round_semantics: A round join whose center and contacts are represented exact values lowers to the existing retained circular conic path. A center retained only in a selected algebraic field returns Unsupported until an algebraic circular-arc carrier exists.
semantic_evidence.strict_policy: STRICT admits only exact axis recognition, selected-field translation, equality/order, join, collapse, arrangement, and winding decisions. A proof failure remains a typed blocker.
semantic_evidence.approximate_512_policy: APPROXIMATE_512 traverses the same operation graph and may terminate only at the shared 512-bit equality authority. Every supported fixture is already exact and remains Certified; the policy does not authorize construction of approximate offset geometry for an unsupported carrier.
semantic_evidence.ordinary_loop_guard: The optimization revision checks for a retained AlgebraicChord before allocating or recognizing this specialized loop. Ordinary native/materialized loops stay on their established fast paths.
semantic_evidence.correctness_repairs: Same-field rational selected points compare by the exact cross-product at their selected root; Exact/Algebraic coordinate equality is attempted before standalone coordinate-root reconstruction; and exact subfragments of an algebraic parent retain a selected-field interior witness usable by algebraic side classification.
